title: Retrolens historic aerial photograph: Nokomai, Southland (1964)
sourceName: Retrolens / Crown Aerial Film Library, available through Wikimedia Commons
credit: LINZ; Retrolens / LINZ and credited rights holders per the linked original file page
altText: Historic black-and-white aerial image of Nokomai, Southland dating to 1964
caption: Retrolens archival aerial view of Nokomai, Southland, 1964. This image documents the earlier film-survey source material used in geospatial mapping and digital imagery archives.
context: The scanned aerial photograph was sourced from Retrolens by its Commons contributor. The uploaded image may have been cropped or annotated; it is stored unchanged from that published Commons source and does not purport to be the untouched film negative.
derivativesNote: The verified Commons upload is preserved unchanged, with separate uncropped WebP derivatives. The upload may differ from the original Crown negative.
